episodes.187192: A several day period of continuous rain caused a rock slide along Highway 20 near Sherman Pass. Rainfall amounts from 0.9 to 1.1 inches fell from November 1 through November 4.
episodes.187450: Heavy rain at the end of October brought flooding to the Cache River at Patterson in early November.

events.narrative: Heavy rain at the end of October brought flooding to the Cache River at Patterson November 3-11.
WSDOT cleared a rockslide on Highway 20 at MP320. No mention of how big the slide was.
